problem_description: Absence of canonical normalization, intent resolution, authorized synonym mapping, and anti-hallucination fallback for the 10 Strategic Financial Questions of the Financial Copilot.
root_cause: Copilot questions were previously handled via informal text matching without canonical intent mapping or strict anti-hallucination fallback enforcement when evidence was missing.
strategy: Normalized the 10 Canonical Strategic Questions (Q-001 through Q-010 / QF-001 through QF-010) in CopilotEngine with deterministic intent resolution (INT-QF-001 to INT-QF-010), non-overlapping authorized synonym matrix, and strict anti-hallucination fallback ('No se puede responder con evidencia suficiente.') for missing evidence without altering DuckDB or financial calculations.
fallback_text: No se puede responder con evidencia suficiente.
